fact: In July 2026 the Sudan Centre for Policy Studies stated that Sudan has no legal framework regulating AI chat systems or personal data, and that the Data and AI Authority and Cybersecurity Authority created by decree in November 2025 had issued no binding rules by mid-2026.
title: فجوة الخصوصية في السودان: الموازنة بين التحول الرقمي وقوانين حماية البيانات
